name: @pipeworx/mcp-bing-news

tools.name: bing_news_search
tools.description: Keyword news search via Bing News RSS, keyless. Returns recent matching articles with title, the real article link (decoded from Bing's tracking redirect, not the redirect itself), publish time, source publication and a short description. Independent of Google News (country_news pack) and GDELT (gdelt pack) — a different vendor on different infrastructure, useful as a corroborating source or when either of those is down.

instructions: @pipeworx/mcp-bing-news forwards to the Pipeworx gateway and lists only the bing-news pack's tools. Set PIPEWORX_META_TOOLS=1 to also list ask_pipeworx and the other gateway-wide tools.
